links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement among ten expert raters of LLM responses
links.effect: Fleiss' kappa ranged from -0.043 to 0.059 (poor to slight); ICC moderate, range 0.259 to 0.692.
links.quote: Inter-rater agreement was poor to slight (Fleiss' kappa range: -0.043 to 0.059) and moderate for ICC (range: 0.259 to 0.692).

screen.reason: The study evaluates four off-the-shelf LLMs across clinical safety, accuracy, and completeness using expert clinician grading of simulated patient queries regarding pregnancy with rheumatic diseases, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
